name: pm-workspace
description: Runs your product-management workspace in a plain folder: file meeting notes and documents with a click, take a feature from rough idea to spec-ready, draft the story or epic for Jira or GitHub issues with its type, epic and labels worked out for your approval, score it for readiness, apply it to the tracker with the project's required fields and workflow remembered after the first time, and keep your decisions, action points and open questions tracked for you. Every write to the tracker or a team repository is previewed and confirmed; nothing is sent on its own.
